_readme: Targeted mutation testing (#64) — hosting-package pure boundaries only.
mutate: deterministic, security/correctness-heavy pure code (DN/input validation, LDIF
generation). Nothing that touches Docker, the AppHost model, or the native LDAP boundary is
mutated: a mutant there would be killed by a container start, not by a contract assertion.
test-case-filter: Category!=Integration&Category!=CleanConsumer — a mutation run must never
start a container or pack-and-boot a consumer AppHost.
thresholds.break: derived from the MEASURED baseline (91.07% at the time of writing),
less a 2-point margin for run-to-run timeout jitter. It is a ratchet: raise it when the
score rises; never lower it to make a run pass. Survivor policy: docs/testing.md.
